sourceDesign.provenanceNote: The three approved PAF-11 core references (League creation ik5JC, League creation validation variants MYsDp, Create match Ranked selector wHaAb) were exported uncropped from the source Pencil document through Pencil MCP at 2x. The source digest above is the digest of the CURRENT docs/design/padel-friend.pen bytes at export time and is re-checked against the file by test/leagues.visual-references.test.ts, so a later design-source change fails here loudly instead of inheriting a stale digest from an older manifest. Chromium comparisons use fresh-preview captures at the exact half-scale reference dimensions with production actor flows; route adaptations are recorded per frame. Supplemental states without an approved frame (multiple eligible Leagues without selection, no eligible League, outside-period edit warning, provisional auto-carry explanation, invalid Ranked-result resolution) reuse the existing consent/error compositions and are gated by structural probes only; their Pencil frames are requested separately and no budget exists for them.

ik5JC.png.certifies: League creation: name, Fixed End Date and Open-ended mode choice with date summary, minimum matches, create action and one-Active guidance

MYsDp.png.certifies: League creation validation variants: end-before-start, missing end date and the explicit Active League conflict with review action

wHaAb.png.certifies: Create match with Competitive Ranked/Unranked status control, eligible League selector and members-only guidance

ik5JC: section order: title, name, end-mode choice, dates, minimum matches, submit, one-Active guidance
keyboard arrow selection of the end mode toggles the end-date field
no horizontal overflow or controls outside the viewport
every interactive target is at least 44×44px (both axes)
pt-BR and es light 390px and dark 320px with an 80-character League name stay unclipped
section boxes span the 18px-margin reference column; name, mode group and minimum fields are inset ≤16px inside them; submit is 44–52px tall and spans the column
vertical geometry (document px, budget-independent): title/name/mode/minimum/submit/guidance tops within ±12px of the approved composition; submit→guidance gap 10±4px (reference rhythm)
MYsDp: Active conflict card names the Active League, states the condition and links to it
end-before-start and missing end date use the exact approved copy
errors are associated through aria-describedby, announced as alerts and focus the first invalid field
error colour differs from body text colour
each validation variant (end-before-start, missing end date) is captured and budgeted separately with its own error visible
error line sits below and within the column of its own end-date field; conflict card spans the 18px-margin column and contains its review link

vertical geometry (document px, budget-independent): conflict card and review link tops within ±12px, review link bottom 14±4px above card bottom; end field top ±12px and its error 27±4px below it, for both variants
wHaAb: competition status is a named group with 44px Ranked/Unranked radios, arrow-key operable
one eligible League defaults to Ranked with the League explicitly shown in the selector
selector order: match type, competition status, eligible League, members-only guidance
guidance is associated with the group through aria-describedby
several overlapping Leagues leave the selector empty and publication shows an associated required-selection alert
competition group and League selector stay inside the reference column; radios, selector and guidance boxes are contained in the group box
vertical geometry (document px, budget-independent): type, group, radios, League selector and guidance tops within ±12px; type→group 3±4px and selector→guidance 17±4px

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture at reference pixelSize / 2 using Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1. Downsample only the uncropped 2x Pencil PNG. Compare same-size RGBA pixels with the pinned perceptual threshold (35215 × 0.1²); reject any dimension mismatch before applying the per-screen budget.
visualBudgets.reason: Every screen has an exact-dimension production-flow capture plus the structural probes above. Budgets are the smallest two-decimal value above the measured Chromium residual; they never replace or relax a probe.

perScreenRationale.ik5JC: Production form renders translated, tokenized controls instead of the mock: a description field, native date inputs with labels and helper text, the real app shell header and bottom navigation, and a dynamic start/end summary instead of the fixed 01 Oct–20 Dec sample. Observed residual 0.17503; 0.18 leaves 0.00497 for raster variance. Order, association, keyboard and target-size probes are exact.
perScreenRationale.MYsDp: Envelope of the two validation-variant captures (see variantBudgets): the frame certifies end-before-start AND missing end date, each captured separately with its own error visible at the exact 431px reference viewport inside the real route shell. Envelope residual 0.23219 (worst variant); 0.24 leaves 0.00781. The earlier single capture (0.12105) did not contain either error line and is superseded. Exact copy, association, alert, focus and link probes plus column/error geometry gate the content.
perScreenRationale.wHaAb: Production wizard step 1 shows real form controls (native date/time inputs, venue and map fields) in place of the mock's chip-style presentation, and the real selector option text with the dynamic League window. Observed residual 0.17052; 0.18 leaves 0.00948. Selector order, radio group semantics, 44px targets, guidance association and the required-selection alert are exact probes.

MYsDp.endNotAfterStart: Capture scrolls the end-before-start error ('End date must be later than start date.') into the 431px viewport: production shows the real create-form fields and bottom guidance around the error line instead of the pattern sheet's two stacked cards, so the residual is higher than a capture of the conflict card alone. Observed residual 0.23219; 0.24 leaves 0.00781. Exact copy, aria-describedby association, alert, focus, colour, error-below-own-field geometry and conflict-card/link geometry gate the structure.
MYsDp.endRequired: Capture scrolls the missing-end-date error ('Fixed End Date requires an end date.') into the 431px viewport with the same production form context. Observed residual 0.2313; 0.24 leaves 0.0087. Exact copy, association, alert, colour and error-below-own-field geometry gate the structure.
